The '''''Eucliptan Morae''''' was a [[BR-23 courier]] constructed by [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]]. It served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a personnel transport and courier before being phased out of military service and refitted to civilian specifications. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], ''Eucliptan Morae'' was purchased by [[Aloren Breesa]]'s partisan group and filled with supplies for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Breesa directed new Alliance recruits to transport the supplies to the Rebellion.<ref name="NRRG" />
